subject.title: fix: surface Claude CLI OAuth reauth hints

question: Should maintainers make this PR the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97553, or prefer one of the overlapping open fixes?
rationale: Multiple contributor PRs implement the same auth-provider recovery path, and automation should not choose the permanent branch or close siblings without maintainer intent.

options.title: Use This PR As Canonical
options.body: Land this branch after maintainer auth-provider review, then close or supersede the sibling fixes while preserving any uniquely useful proof or tests.

options.title: Prefer The Proof Sibling
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97669 if maintainers prefer its command shape or proof history, then close this PR as superseded after that path is chosen.

options.title: Pause For Owner Shape
options.body: Hold the overlapping PRs until an auth/runtime owner chooses the final classifier boundary and recovery wording.

recommendation.title: Use This PR As Canonical
recommendation.body: Land this branch after maintainer auth-provider review, then close or supersede the sibling fixes while preserving any uniquely useful proof or tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the OAuth re-auth reply machinery that this PR extends, making them the strongest history-backed branch-selection owner.
